app.name: Libellus
app.tagline: The books you read, kept quietly.

rating.label: {value} of 5 stars

error.invite_invalid: We don't recognise that invite code.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: We'll email you a six-digit code. No password.
signIn.configMissing: Missing {key}. Copy web/.env.example to web/.env and fill it in.
signIn.configInvalidUrl: The Supabase URL "{value}" is not a valid address.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.intro: Libellus is invite-only. Your code comes from whoever invited you.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.sentTo: We sent a six-digit code to {email}.

home.empty: Find the book on your nightstand, or the one you want to read next.
home.readingEmpty: Nothing in progress. Start something from Up next, or search for a book.
home.loadError: Your books could not be loaded.

library.title: Library
library.empty: The books you add live here: what you want to read, what you are reading, what you have read.

want_to_read.title: Nothing to read next
want_to_read.text: Books you want to read gather here, newest first.

reading.title: Nothing on the nightstand
reading.text: The books you are reading now will be here.

finished.title: No finished books yet
finished.text: Every book you finish lands here, with its date and rating.

notFinishedEmpty.title: Nothing set aside
notFinishedEmpty.text: Books you stop reading are kept here, so you can pick them up again.

library.loadError: Your Library didn't load. Check your connection and try again.

error.already_in_library: This book is already in your Library.
error.book_invalid: This book can't be added: it is missing what we need to keep it.
error.session_invalid: Those dates, that rating or review don't go with that status.
error.not_signed_in: Sign in again to add books.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.entry_not_found: This book isn't in your Library any more.
error.already_reading: You are reading this book already.
error.not_reading: You aren't reading this book at the moment.
error.ended_before_started: That is before you started it. Pick the start day or later.
error.rating_invalid: A rating is between a quarter star and five stars.
error.review_too_long: That review is longer than we can keep. Shorten it a little.
error.reason_too_long: That reason is longer than we can keep. Shorten it a little.
error.never_read: You haven't read this book yet. Start reading it first.
error.session_not_found: That read isn't there any more. It may have been deleted on another device.

search.title: Search
search.empty: Find a book by its title, author or ISBN.
search.noResultsHint: Check the spelling, or search the ISBN of the edition you hold. Or add it by hand; books you add yourself stay private.
search.failed: Check your connection and try again.
search.hint: Not the edition you hold? Search its ISBN.
search.offlineNote: You're offline, so only your Library is searched.

book.title: Book
book.missing: There is no book at this address.
book.error: Check your connection and try again.

manual.title: Add manually
manual.private: Only you can see this book. It stays out of the shared catalogue.

invalid.title: Give the book a title.
invalid.author: Give the book an author.
invalid.isbn: That isn't a valid ISBN. Check the digits, or leave it empty.
invalid.pageCount: Pages must be a whole number above zero.

error.book_invalid: This book can't be added: check the title, author and pages.
error.isbn_invalid: That isn't a valid ISBN. Check the digits, or leave it empty.
error.already_in_library: This book is already in your Library.
error.not_signed_in: Sign in again to add books.

abandon.title: Abandon reading
abandon.reasonPlaceholder: Why are you putting it down?

collections.title: Collections
collections.intro: Your own shelves. A book can sit on any number of them.
collections.empty: Group your books your own way: favourites, a genre, gifts for someone.
collections.loadError: Your collections didn't load. Check your connection and try again.
collections.addsToLibrary: Not in your Library yet: putting it on a collection adds it to Want to read.

error.name_invalid: Give the collection a name of up to 80 characters.
error.name_taken: You already have a collection with that name.
error.collection_missing: That collection is gone. It may have been deleted on another device.
error.already_in_collection: This book is already on that collection.
error.not_in_collection: This book isn't on that collection any more.
error.order_mismatch: The collection changed elsewhere. This is its order now.
error.book_invalid: This book can't be added to a collection.
error.not_signed_in: Sign in again to change your collections.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

collection.deleteKeeps: The books on it stay in your Library.
collection.empty: Find a book and choose Add to collection on its page.
collection.moveHint: Drag to move it, or use the arrow keys.
collection.reorderError: The new order couldn't be saved. This is the order your collection has.
collection.error: Check your connection and try again.

history.title: Reading history
history.loadError: The history didn't load. Check your connection and try again.

editSession.title: Edit read
editSession.reasonPlaceholder: Why did you put it down?

deleteSession.title: Delete this read?
deleteSession.only: It is the only one, so the book goes back to Want to read.

removeEntry.title: Remove “{title}” from your Library?
removeEntry.text: Its reads and its places on your collections go with it. The collections stay.

import.title: Import books
import.pickText: On Goodreads: My Books → Import and export → Export library. From Fable: a Goodreads CSV from a browser extension.
import.matchingHint: Finding each book's edition and cover. You can leave this page; it keeps going.
import.inFile: No books in this file | One book in this file | {count} books in this file

note.fromFile: No edition found. Added with what the file says.
note.unsure: Couldn't be looked up. Added with what the file says.
note.otherShelf: On your shelf “{shelf}”. Added as Want to read.
note.notFinishedRating: Rating or review left out: only finished books keep them.
note.ratingInvalid: Rating left out: it isn't 1 to 5 stars.
note.dateInvalid: A date left out: it isn't a day, or it hasn't come yet.
note.reviewTooLong: Review shortened to the 10,000 characters we keep.
note.duplicate: Skipped: it is in the file twice.

import.nothingToImport: Everything in this file is in your Library already.
import.importingHint: Adding the books and their covers. You can leave this page; it keeps going.
import.doneTitle: Nothing new added | One book added | {count} books added

import.doneNothing: Your Library already had every book in this file.

fileError.notGoodreads: That isn't a Goodreads export. Choose the CSV from Export library.
fileError.empty: There are no books in that file.
